newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE IN HIGH DEMAND ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE IN HIGH DEMAND ON BOURSE.

text.p: Rakvere meat factory was in high demand on Wednesday in trade of 16.2 million kroons and dealers said that its trunover took them by surprise.
Rakvere ended 0.75 kroons higher at 15.50 kroons.
"It had an exceptional turnover and its trade in large blocks was also unusual," one dealer said.
"I expect an explanation to the unusual turnover later this week...probably some news is expected," he added.
Another dealer said investors are taking their positions and are not willing to sell them as they see potential for growth.
On the main list, investors' interest in Hansapank and Hoiupank continued.
Hansa saw turnover of 17.35 kroons and Hoiu was in trade of 12.2 million kroons and the prices for both remained relatively stable.
Tallinna Pank was the biggest loser on the main list, to close at 63.30 kroons versus 64.05 kroons.
One dealer said investors might start selling Hoiupank and Hansapank later this week and start buying Forekspank and Tallinna Pank, which have fallen.
Dealers said no big change is expected in the market.
"The main attention now is directed at the new shares coming to the market," one dealer said.
